name: Wooden gallows
description: A weathered timber gallows: a braced plank platform with a hinged trapdoor and release lever, a steep flight of steps with a handrail, and over the trapdoor two tall uprights carrying a cross beam on knee braces, one rope wound round it and hanging to a coiled noose.

provenance.prompt: A plank platform with steps, a beam and one noose, about 3 × 2.5 × 4 m.
